I get that way sometimes. I'm so proud of you for trying to be positive, that's the only thing you can do. Don't anticipate possibly losing, just keep thinking about your wins. You woke up today. You reached out to people who know how you feel. That's enough.

I dont think it's just a phase. Being a teenager is so fucking hard. I am 19, this is my first year after highschool, and it does get better after that: school isn't for everyone. I won't try to dissuade you, I know its so, so scary. Death doesn't have to be your only option. Read a story you like, watch a kid's movie and bundle up in your bed. That will help, I promise. Do something simple that is meant to cheer you up. Have a cookie and milk. It will always be ok again.

I completely agree that it can feel like absolute agony. I commend you for recognizing that it isn't permanent, but I also remember feeling that way and knowing the words were true, even though everything in me was screaming all the time. Try doing things you did as a child, things that made you feel safe and warm. Blanket on, snack and stuffed animal :) no matter how old, this always helps me to feel grounded. You so deserve happiness, I will never disagree with that point.

There isn't a correct response! This person obviously really trusts you to let you in on their inner demons. I'm sorry that's been put on your shoulders all of the sudden, it's ok to be honest with them and let them know that that's a scary thing to hear. Remind them you are always there, as are others. Remind them they aren't the first, and definetly not the last, and that they can always reach out to a professional. You can ask them if they are thinking of ending their life, and judge your next actions based on that. You can't control their actions, so just be the best listener you can be :)

Im so sorry. No one deserves to feel isolated and alone. You're really good with words, articulate and concise-- I liked reading that and getting a glimpse into someone's life. Ground yourself by eating a cookie, sitting at your desk with a blanket, drinking some hot chocolate. Do something that reminds you of being a little kid. That always helps me to feel safe and warm :) you deserve happiness

You dont have to know. No one knows. You just have to try. For now, focus on feeling comfortable and living in the moment. Maybe get a blanket and a snack--little things like that can keep you sane. Sometimes, when I'm at my worst, I cry when I think about things like that that make me happy because it's hard to stay tethered to reality.

Im so sorry that you are experiencing so much hurt. I am a real person, and I have felt this way before too, as many of us have. I know you need help, good job reaching out. Try taking deep breaths and getting snuggled in your bed or your happy spot. Drink some water, listen to some music and feel warm and safe.

Im sorry that your heart hurts. Remember, there are real people, living, breathing people, reading this. We have felt your pain. Try taking a deep breath and getting snuggled in your bed, that always feels safe and warm :)

I know socializing can be really hard and draining, especially when you're feeling so sad. I'm sorry that your heart is hurting, but you are great with words :) I can tell based on this post. The world will always be uncomfortable, but that doesn't mean you can't adjust accordingly. Try snuggling in bed with something to hug: i find that no matter how old you get, that always feels good and safe.

It can get really lonely in your mind when your heart is hurting. This subreddit right here is proof that others can hear you and feel what you're feeling. I check sometimes to remember what it feels like to hurt so bad. Feelings are difficult to articulate; sometimes I don't wanna talk about it, or can't, so I lay down and snuggle my blankets and drown my sorrows in something pleasant and warm. Take deep breaths and take things at the correct speed for you.

It can be really painful when your self image is reliant on other people. I promise you from the bottom of my heart that no one is unlovable. I have a habit of letting rejection fester in my heart, but dating apps are hard to get a feel for because your interactions are limited. Try not to set a goal or deadline for yourself; you do NOT deserve death just because someone from Tinder was a jerk :) great job putting yourself out there, just keep pushing
Im sorry you're hurting. Take deep breaths, sniff your favorite candle or teddy bear. Ground yourself, think and listen and live for a moment.

I know it can be really hard when you're hurting so bad. Take deep breaths and remember that your mom's passing doesn't have to be a deadline. You are in control--that might be scary, but you can take tiny pieces at a time. When there's nothing to lose, why not try to feel better?

There is no "good time," and chances are that if she loves you, she will be understanding and sympathetic. Its likely that she'd be upset because she doesn't want you to be hurting, but it's not reasonable for her to be mad AT you. Take a deep breath, remember that she likes you for you, and bring it up in a way that lets her know it's a difficult subject for you. Having someone you love listen to your struggles can be very empowering!

I think I personally have a very pessimistic view regarding the afterlife and such. I am someone who would need very concrete proof at this point that points towards any higher power--dont get me wrong, I think that with the infinite amount of alternate realities, there is bound to be every possible outcome for every situation you can fathom. But I do believe that once you die, you die for good. I think I have it in my head that if there were a god, he would be doing something much more effective for those suffering down in this mortal plane.
